title: XHR poll error
symptom: When setting up AAPS Nightscout settings with https://mynasdns:4443, AAPS systematically gets 'xhr poll error'. The connection appears to be established on the NAS side and data seems to arrive, but AAPS is stuck on the error.
cause: The issue is related to the reverse proxy configuration on the NAS; specifically, the protocol used for the connection. The user found that selecting WebSocket instead of HTTP on the reverse proxy resolved the issue.
fix: Select WebSocket instead of HTTP on the reverse proxy of the NAS.
evidence_quote: The only thing to do was to select WebSocket instead of HTTP on the reverse proxy of the NAS.
